raw_segments.text: fasten the door securely on the inside. Wake Sophie when you go upstairs under
pretense of requesting her to rouse you in good time tomorrow, for you must be
dressed and have finished breakfast before 8. And now no more somber thoughts.
Chase dull care away, Janet. Don't you hear to what soft whispers the wind has
fallen, and there is no more beating of rain against the window panes. Look here,
he lifted up the curtain. It is a lovely night.
